act_title: The Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act, 2016.
title: Penalty for non-compliance with intimation requirements
text:
41. Penalty for non-compliance with intimation requirements.—Whoever, being an enrolling

agency or a requesting entity, fails to comply with the requirements of sub-section (2) of section 3 or subsection (3) of section 8, shall be [liable to penalty which may extend to one lakh rupees, or in the case of
a company, with penalty which may extend to ten lakh rupees].
